claimReviews.question: Combined daily-energy estimate
claimReviews.finding: The summed estimate remains unvalidated; differing compensation studies do not validate the specific baseline, walking or session mapping.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Retain an illustrative estimate; no universal compensation multiplier or daily intake target.

claimReviews.reversalTrigger: New contrary evidence, changed methods/rights or consequential reuse; reopen the named downstream evaluation.

claimReviews.question: Cohort intervals and sensitivity do not provide individual error bounds
claimReviews.finding: A cohort sampling interval concerns an estimated statistic; conditional scenarios are neither individual coverage nor measurement-error bounds.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Do not display bootstrap intervals as a personal prediction range.

claimReviews.question: A synthetic overlap assignment changes one example by 174.30 kcal/day; low-step inputs share an assumed baseline plateau.

claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Use explicit scenario assumptions; clock overlap cannot identify merged step contribution.

contradictions.resolution: Preserve design, population, duration and measured/derived component distinctions. No pooled effect or universal correction; both supporting and opposing findings retained.
